name: Couchlink
summary: Pair a phone with a TV: type the code the TV shows and a beam of light carries it across
about: A cosy living room with a TV on a wooden cabinet and a phone held in front of it. The TV shows a 6-character pairing code with an expiry bar, and its tiles light up as the phone fills in each box. A right code sends a beam of glowing dots to the TV, which switches like an old set and opens on a welcome screen with shows to continue.
how: Read the code on the TV screen and type it into the boxes on the phone
Paste works too; backspace, Delete and the arrow keys move between boxes
A full code pairs by itself (or press Pair TV); a wrong one shakes and counts your tries
Press New code on the TV for a fresh code; it also renews itself when the bar runs out
Press Unpair TV to go back and pair again
